title: Steel check (source)
description: Woodcore-Datei/steel/<id>.json -- one steel check of Woodcore's «Acier» tabs (issues #50-#52, spec 2026-10-12-section-acier D-12; docs/domain/steel.md). Read and checked by calc/domains/steel_check.py (`check_source`), resolved against the positions and the free profiles at the export, computed there, and written into data/steel.json. 1.1 adds `links` (a field following a variable of the export).

group.description: The folder of the tab's left pane.

kind.description: The check: class, tension, compression, bending and shear are built (lot 1); the others are refused as not implemented yet.

position.description: The position the check follows, or null.

profile.description: null follows the position's section; else the profile stated: an SZS C5 code and its size («IPE», «360») or USR and a free profile's id.

grade.description: null follows the position's strength class; else a grade of SIA 263 Tabelle 1.

A_net.description: A tension's net area in mm², SIA 263 (39); null: the gross section only.

links.description: 1.1: the fields that follow a variable (docs/domain/variable-links.md).
